column1: # The code defaults of the stage settings: what a setting comes to when a deploy gets no value for it and the stage keeps none. scripts/lib/deploy.py
# reads this file (SETTING_DEFAULTS), and so does setup.sh, for the plan of an update (a new default that the stage would not take). infra/lib/config.ts holds
# the same values; scripts/tests/test_setup_deploy_settings.py pins the two together.
# Plain data: it is never sourced or evaluated. A line that starts with # is a comment; a blank line is ignored.
# Two fields: NAME|DEFAULT. An empty DEFAULT is no value. The utility model and its purposes take their default from the model catalog and the stage
# Region, and the keep tag and the stage kind from the role of the account entry, so they have no row here.
